purpose: Recomputed offline from the saved 3,168-record WinoBias run using parser v2. One seed; provisional and pending manual review; not final reproduction results.
osb_denominator_convention: sentences of given gender containing the occupation as a candidate; local operationalization
failure_policy: failed executions are excluded from rates and counted explicitly; Type 2 unresolved or explicit Unknown answers are incorrect for RPA; Unknown and unresolved answers select no occupation for O-SB/A-SB, whose denominator retains all eligible records

notes: The review flag marks a local parser convention and does not by itself mean that the source example is invalid.

No additional seeds or significance tests are included in this run.

audit_metadata.correlation_scope_note: The paper reports the main correlation over occupation-level O-SB on the WinoBias set; Type 1 and Type 2 correlations are included here as separate local analyses. All are single-seed descriptive values; no p-values are computed.
audit_metadata.selection_policy: For O-SB/A-SB, use one candidate occupation explicitly named in the first non-empty answer line; an explicit Unknown answer or unresolved line selects no occupation. This is a local convention.
audit_metadata.rpa_policy: For Type 2 RPA, require exactly one candidate occupation in the full generated text, matching gold; an explicit Unknown answer is incorrect. This operationalizes the paper wording locally.
audit_metadata.parser_v2_changed_input: derived parsing and metrics only; model outputs unchanged
